_note: Copy this to creds.json, fill in real credentials, then gpg-encrypt to creds.json.gpg. NEVER commit unencrypted creds.json.

albertsons._note: Albertsons family — uses ACME login by default. To test other family members, set 'storeId' here.

amazon._note: 2FA: if you have OTP-via-email or SMS enabled, the test will pause and prompt you in the terminal.

kroger._note: Kroger uses OAuth (not username/password). The live test triggers a one-time OAuth flow and stores the refresh token in this file. Run `npm run test:live:kroger-bootstrap` once to set up.
